content.short: Symbiotic is a permissionless restaking protocol that enables decentralized networks to bootstrap security using any asset.
content.description:
Symbiotic is a pioneering decentralized restaking protocol designed to provide "security-as-a-service" for a wide range of blockchain networks and Actively Validated Services (AVS). Unlike previous models that were limited to specific assets, Symbiotic's modular architecture allows any ERC-20 token to be used as collateral to secure decentralized infrastructure. This enables projects to choose their own custom collateral assets, node operators, and slashing parameters, fostering a more inclusive and flexible security environment.

Operating on the Ethereum network, the platform focuses on providing high-throughput and professional-grade security coordination without centralized intermediaries. Symbiotic serves as a foundational layer for the next generation of decentralized services, including oracles, bridges, and sidechains, by allowing them to leverage existing capital for robust protection. Through its commitment to transparency and permissionless innovation, Symbiotic is building the essential framework for a more resilient and Interconnected decentralized economy, where shared security is a globally accessible utility.
